summary: One intentional governed INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION phase (alias N16-5-F-5-B2R-IV, canonical phase 149O.20L.7O.3W.1R.2B.1R.1.1R.30R.5R.2.1R.1R.2R.1R.1R.1R.1.1R.1R.1R.1R.1R.1R.1R.1R.1R.1R.1.1R.1R.1R.1R.1R.1R.1R.1R.1R.1R.1R.1R.1R.1R.1R.1R.1), reconstructing and adversarially probing the N16-5-F-5-B2R-IMPL repair to src/pcae/core/hpac_protected_admin_writer.py from primary source, not from the predecessor's own report. CPIPC: candidate = predecessor N16-5-F-5-B2R-IMPL plus exactly one direct '.1' segment, independently confirmed via pcae.core.phase_id (same series, same branch, compare=greater, unique against full git history, no active conflicting phase). Independently confirmed both disclosed forgery classes remain denied: the predecessor's exact exec()-crafted frame.f_globals['__name__'] forgery, and sys.modules poisoning via a hand-built module with no genuine SourceFileLoader provenance -- both independently re-tested and PASS (denied). BLOCKING FINDING: the process-local trust-pin state (_PINNED_CODE_OBJECTS / _PINNED_TRUSTED_MODULES / _CODE_OBJECT_KEEPALIVE) is ordinary, unencapsulated module-level mutable dict/list state protected only by leading-underscore naming convention, not by any real access control. A new independently-authored adversarial test (tests/test_phase_n16_5_f5b2r_iv_independent_verification.py::test_BLOCKING_ordinary_code_can_overwrite_pin_state_to_impersonate_authorized_consumer) proves a full end-to-end bypass: an ordinary in-process module (on no consumer allowlist) directly overwrites the pin dicts, then invokes production_writer via a single exec() against the real target module's own __dict__ (an ordinary, caller-obtainable object via sys.modules[name].__dict__) and receives a genuine, live ProductionWriterHandle -- with no forged __name__, no sys.modules poisoning, and no import-provenance spoof. This directly violates the IV's required negative-authenticity property (an ordinary caller must not obtain privileged authority by manipulating process-local mutable state) and pass criterion #17. The same primitive is shared verbatim by all four privileged factories (production_writer, certification_writer, recognized_certification_read_authority, mint_protected_presentation_evidence_writer), so the finding is not scoped to a single factory. No production source was modified in this phase (verification-only scope); the defect is documented, not repaired, per the phase's own early-stop discipline for a critical product defect found. Given the decisive blocking finding, this phase did NOT exhaustively complete every adversarial sub-check in the authorizing prompt (clean-installed-wheel rebuild, sdist boundary, full fast_green rerun, exhaustive five-role negative sweep, generic-writer symbolic grep, decoy/lookalike variants for all four factories individually) -- these remain open and unresolved by this phase, and do not change the BLOCKED verdict since one confirmed critical bypass already fails the IV. VERDICT: N16-5-F-5-B2R-IV COMPLETE -- NOT VERIFIED / BLOCKED. F-5-B2: BLOCKED. F-5: CERTIFICATION BLOCKED. N-16-5: NOT CLOSED. N-16-6 / N-16-7: OPEN / UNTOUCHED; N-16-7 strictly last. Runtime posture unchanged: Observed / observe / unavailable / 0 plugins / 0 capabilities; first governed runtime external effect ABSENT / UNREACHABLE. No live production/HPAC/PPA/FIDO2 mutation; no real certification ceremony performed. Required successor derived, NOT begun: a fresh governed repair phase that closes the process-local mutable-state gap via real encapsulation of the pin state (not merely underscore-prefixed module attributes).
